violations.why: ISR overwrites the loop counter with 50 between the init to 0 and the loop condition check.
The condition check and the array index use are not atomic. The ISR changes the counter in between, so the index differs from the one that was checked.
The ISR sets the counter after the index is read and before the increment reads it, so the increment uses a stale or changed value.
The increment is a read-modify-write. The ISR write is lost or overridden when the stale value plus 1 is stored.
The ISR overwrites the freshly incremented counter before the loop condition reads it, so the loop restarts from 50.
